get.summary: Read an app's desktop portable release

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: latest or the release SHA-256 followed by .zib

200.description: Signed release metadata or the portable bundle

403.description: The artifact is gated; v2 serves it with a grant

get.summary: Read an app's portable release for current hosts

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: latest or the release SHA-256 followed by .zib

parameters.name: host_api
parameters.description: For latest: the newest host interface the app runs; an older archived release is served when the latest needs a newer one

parameters.name: module_api
parameters.description: For latest: the module interface the app requires

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: For latest: the device's stable rollout bucket; a staged release reaches buckets below its share until it expires. Apps without a bucket count as 99

200.description: Signed release metadata or the portable bundle

403.description: The artifact is gated; request it with a grant

404.description: App or release is unavailable, or no release fits the app

get.summary: Read a gated portable artifact with a download grant

parameters.name: grant
parameters.description: An unexpired grant from POST /api/v1/unlocks/grant for the artifact's product. Artifacts that are not gated ignore it

200.description: The portable bundle; private, no-store when gated

403.description: The artifact is gated and the grant is missing, expired, forged or for another product
